prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1174; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This is the recorded statement for claim file reference regarding the intersection collision in Baytown, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you my first name for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving when the collision happened?

A: I was heading east on the main road, going through the intersection on a green light, I'm fairly sure of that.

Q: What happened as you entered the intersection?

A: A vehicle coming from the left side came through the crossing and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't see it until it was already there. I hit the brakes but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you able to get your car to a safe spot afterward?

A: Not right away. The impact spun me a little and I stopped partly in the lane. Someone pulled over to help and the police came out.

Q: Did you receive any medical attention?

A: I was checked at the scene and then went to an urgent care center later that day. My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches when I sit too long. I've been told it's a strain.

Q: Have you been able to keep up with your normal activities since then?

A: Some things are harder. Lifting groceries hurts, and I've had to take time off from my shifts while the pain settles down.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your account?

A: Only that I'm trying to be accurate about what I saw. I'll send over the report and the urgent care paperwork when I get a chance.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
